quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #10
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 28

questions.question: What is the penalty for passing a stopped school bus illegally?

options.text: Loss of driving privileges or vehicle registration, plus a mandatory $300 fine.
A $30 fine and 14-day suspension of driving privileges.

questions.correctAnswerText: Loss of driving privileges or vehicle registration, plus a mandatory $300 fine.
questions.explanation: If you are convicted of passing a stopped school bus with flashing lights and a stop arm, your driver license will be suspended. You must also pay a $300 fine and do community service ordered by the court. If the vehicle owner was not driving, they must tell the State's Attorney's Office who was driving. If they don't, their vehicle registration will be suspended for three months.

questions.question: A sign with this shape means:
questions.explanation: A yellow diamond-shaped sign warns drivers of possible danger ahead. Orange diamond-shaped signs warn of dangers in or near work areas.

questions.question: If a tire suddenly goes flat while you are driving, you should:

options.text: Pump the brake pedal quickly several times.
Press the brake pedal down as hard as you can.

questions.explanation: If a tire goes flat while driving, hold the steering wheel firmly and keep the vehicle straight. Take your foot off the gas pedal. Do not brake. Let the vehicle slow on its own. Use the brakes gently only if needed. Pull off the road safely.

questions.question: This sign indicates:

options.text: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows the distance from the road surface to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this example, the clearance is 12 feet 6 inches.

questions.question: When entering the interstate on a short entrance ramp with no acceleration lane, you should:

options.text: Enter the far-right lane right away and speed up to match traffic.
Use the shoulder of the main road to speed up to match traffic.
Speed up only after you find a gap in traffic, then enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up only after you find a gap in traffic, then enter.
questions.explanation: On a short entrance ramp with no acceleration lane, wait for a gap in traffic to appear. Then speed up and enter the interstate. Generally, you should wait while stopped until you see a safe gap.

questions.question: An orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle means:
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back. These include farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts.

questions.question: You can wear a dual ear headset while driving.
questions.explanation: In Illinois, wearing a headset while driving is illegal. A headset is any device that lets you hear or receive electronic communications, except for a hearing aid. You can use a single-sided headset or earpiece with a cell phone. Motorcycle and moped riders may use intercom helmets to talk to each other.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that tells drivers what they must do. When you see this sign, you must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: You can pass another vehicle by driving on the shoulder of the road.
questions.explanation: You cannot leave the road or main travel area to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: You are driving defensively when you:

options.text: Keep one car length between you and the car ahead.
Look only at the car in front of you.
Keep your eyes moving to spot possible hazards.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your eyes moving to spot possible hazards.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means looking ahead for possible hazards. Staring only at the road directly in front of your car is dangerous. Scan ahead and watch the vehicles around you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a side road is ahead.

questions.question: A solid yellow line next to a broken yellow line means vehicles can:

options.text: Pass if they are next to the broken line.
Pass if they are next to the solid line.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pass if they are next to the broken line.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken yellow line means you may pass when it is safe.

questions.question: When entering traffic from a parked position at a curb, you should:

options.text: Drive slower than other traffic for 200 feet.
Wait for a gap large enough to match the speed of other traffic.
Wait for the first two vehicles to pass, then drive into the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for a gap large enough to match the speed of other traffic.
questions.explanation: When merging into traffic, wait for a safe gap so your vehicle can reach the same speed as other cars.

questions.question: You must use low beam headlights when:
questions.explanation: Use low beams in fog, snow, rain, or mist. High beams reflect off weather and create glare, making it harder to see.

questions.question: At night, an oncoming car has high beams on and you cannot see well. What should you do?

options.text: Look toward the left edge of your lane.
Look toward the right edge of your lane.
Look straight ahead in your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right edge of your lane.
questions.explanation: Do not look directly at oncoming headlights. Instead, look toward the right edge of your lane and watch the other car from the corner of your eye.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards. Orange is used for construction and maintenance areas.

questions.question: On a road with a broken white centerline, you can:

options.text: Cross it to change lanes when safe.
Change lanes only from the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross it to change lanes when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes going the same direction. A broken white line means you may pass when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road changes direction or narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road changes direction or narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a sharp curve or road narrowing. You may see it before a curve or narrow bridge.

questions.question: Adjust your rearview and side mirrors:

options.text: Whenever you need to use them.
Before you get into the car.

questions.explanation: Adjust your mirrors before moving your vehicle. Also adjust your seat, fasten your safety belt, and secure items. Do not adjust mirrors while driving.

questions.question: Orange signs mean drivers should slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Orange signs are used for construction and maintenance areas. These signs warn of dangers ahead and tell drivers to slow down and proceed carefully.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What is this orange triangle symbol used for?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle appears on the back of slow-moving vehicles. You may see it on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks orange during the day and red at night.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Right turns are allowed on red lights.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. It is illegal to turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What do "No passing zone" signs tell drivers?

options.text: It is not safe to pass other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is not safe to pass other vehicles.
questions.explanation: A "No passing zone" sign means you cannot pass other vehicles in that area. The road likely has limited visibility, making it unsafe to pass.

questions.question: What must you do when approaching an intersection with a flashing red light?

options.text: Stop completely, yield to traffic and pedestrians, then go.
Slow down and continue with caution.
Stop and stay stopped until the light turns green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, yield to traffic and pedestrians, then go.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop and then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Yield to all traffic before entering the intersection.
Stop, then enter when it is safe.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should slow down to a safe speed and proceed with caution.

questions.question: When changing lanes, what should you never do?

options.text: Cross the centerline in an intersection.
Check your blind spots by looking over your shoulder.
Check for other drivers moving into the same lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross the centerline in an intersection.
questions.explanation: Never change lanes or pass in an intersection. Always check for drivers in your blind spot and look for other cars entering your lane.

questions.question: When parking or leaving a curb, when should you use your turn signals?

options.text: Only when pulling away from the curb.
Only when pulling next to the curb.
When pulling next to or away from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pulling next to or away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Use your turn signals both when parking at a curb and when leaving it.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right for road construction.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to slow down and prepare for an abrupt sharp turn in the road.

questions.question: When should you yield to a pedestrian?

options.text: Only if they are in a crosswalk.
Always, even if they are breaking traffic laws.
Only if traffic lights favor them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always, even if they are breaking traffic laws.
questions.explanation: Always protect pedestrians. Do everything possible to avoid hitting a pedestrian, no matter the circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may be merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means a steep hill is ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: You may drive through a railroad crossing after a train passes only when the lights stop flashing and you see no other trains coming.
questions.explanation: You may proceed through a railroad crossing only when the gate is fully raised, the lights stop flashing, or a flagger signals you to go. Always look both ways to check for other trains before proceeding.
